components.name: mvp

excluded.name: ufs370
excluded.reason: Not installed by pinned sysgen or MVP. Superseded by UFSD: libufs is 'a drop-in replacement for ufs370', and UFSD is based on Rayborn's 'in-address-space UFS370 filesystem'. An in-address-space design conflicts with spec section 3 (one cross-address-space filesystem owner).
excluded.evidence: grep -i ufs370 over sysgen@4746195d *.py *.conf README.md jcl/ and MVP cache: no hits; ufsd README@1a63bf52 l.6, l.99, l.106; ufs370 README@f1f209a8 (license MIT per API, not read).
excluded.revisit: If OSE-005 finds UFSD unsuitable, re-evaluate UFS370 (it advertises symlinks and access control).
